html:
A master sergeant of the Krahn people who seized power in a coup on 12 April 1980, killing President William Tolbert, and ruled Liberia until he was captured and killed in September 1990.

Thirteen former ministers were shot on a Monrovia beach soon after. Doe was the first Liberian ruler from the native majority, not the Americo-Liberians, and many cheered at first. He became a brutal ruler who favoured his Krahn, won a rigged election in 1985 and got large US aid as a Cold War ally. In 1989 Charles Taylor invaded and began the civil war. Rebels of Prince Johnson captured Doe, tortured him on video and killed him.
